descriptor: Gentle habit tracker with forgiving streaks

voice.summary: Sounds like a friend giving you a warm nudge, never a drill sergeant. It celebrates showing up and treats a missed day as normal.
dos: Use warm light and fire words sparingly
Keep reminders to one kind sentence

taglines: The gentlest way to keep going
A warm nudge at the right time
boilerplate: Kindle Habit is a mobile habit tracker with forgiving streaks, quiet reminders and insights that celebrate consistency without guilt.

microcopy.error: Could not save that habit, try again
microcopy.empty: No habits yet, start with one small thing

logo.note: A small flame fits the kindle idea of warming up a habit slowly.
